Name: (AT) Flowery Farmhouse
Author: SimplyMary
Description:
This is far from perfect as it was merely a little test to see how I felt about making my own textures for the game. I tend to prefer a softer sort of painting-esque look so this might not be to everyone's taste in terms of how it looks in game.

-Nonseasonal, 1-variant
-Might make seasonal versions later, but have no plans for it at this time
-New to textures and modding so if there's issues I'll do my best to fix them but please be patient with me ;-;

Art belongs to me, do whatever you want with it so long as you credit me.

Obv requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] to work.

All my in-game screenshots are taken using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1213]Natural Color[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolor[/url] since that's what I play my game with, however it shouldn't have problems with any other recolor or vanilla.
